MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

2. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 8
   C. 16
   D. 5

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 22
   C. 28
   D. 14

4. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 144

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 5
   D. 7

7. Solve for x: x + 3 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 9
   C. 3
   D. 8

8. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 2

9. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

10. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27
   D. 27.7

11. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 24

13. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 56
   C. 15
   D. 57

14. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 50

15. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

16. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 3
   C. 41
   D. 13

17. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

18. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 33

19. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 13

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 45
   C. 18
   D. 36

21. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

22. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

23. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

24. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 24
   C. 25
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
